name: presenter-mode
title: Presenter Mode
description: Presenting mode where values wrapped in <Sensitive> are removed from the page (not blurred) behind fixed-length masks, a visible bar shows the mode is on, a deliberate hold peeks one value, and starting a screen share in this tab suggests turning it on.

meta.stops: Leaked a key on a screen share
meta.summary: Removes marked emails, amounts and keys from the page while presenting, so they don't leak on a screen share.
catches: Sensitive values visible during a screen share
Blur that can be reversed or read: values are removed, not blurred
Value length given away: masks are fixed-length
Screen share started in this tab: suggests presenting mode
limits: Only hides values you wrap in <Sensitive>
Can detect only screen shares started from this tab with getDisplayMedia, not ones started in another app
Peeking shows the value to the audience too
a11y: Masked values are focusable buttons with an aria-label naming the kind of value
Peek works by holding Space or Enter
Presenting bar uses role=status; icons are aria-hidden
